p01: Classic studio look: hazy cloth backdrop, warm tones and that signature 90s pose.
Great for nostalgia posts. Add "with a painted garden backdrop" for a different background.
p02: An elegant black-and-white portrait like an old family photo.
Use a front-facing photo with even lighting.
p03: Moments with friends in warm 1970s film colors.
Works solo or in a group. With more people, make sure every face is clearly visible.
p04: Turn a damaged, faded photo into a clear, colorful one again.
Scan or re-shoot the old photo in bright light with no glare. Makes a lovely gift for parents.
p05: Kimono in the Streets of Kyoto
Stroll a traditional Kyoto alley in a kimono at dusk.
Swap "at dusk" for "in spring morning" for a cherry-blossom morning mood.
p06: Stand on a hilltop with hundreds of balloons in the sky.
For men, replace "flowing long dress" with "linen shirt and chinos".
p07: An adventurer pose on a rocky cliff facing the open sea.
Add "facing the camera" if you want your face to show.
p08: Ready to Fly at the Airport
A cool silhouette by the big airport window before a trip.
Perfect for holiday or business-trip announcements.
p09: A big family holding hands, facing the setting sun.
Upload several photos if family members are in separate shots. State the number of people in the prompt, e.g. "7 people".
p10: Dad, mom and kids holding hands, playing in the waves.
Use a photo of each family member with a clear face.
p11: A warm, cheerful candid of a father and his kids.
Change it to "mother" for a mom version. Great for Father's Day or Mother's Day.
p12: An aesthetic graduation photo in front of a campus building.
Add a sash color or a generic campus name, e.g. "with a gold sash".
p13: A romantic pre-wedding shoot with a gown and long veil by the sea.
Upload a photo of you both, or two separate photos. For modest wear, add "the bride wears an elegant hijab".
p14: Silhouetted hands forming a heart against the sunset.
Add "with the text Happy 5th Anniversary" if you want text, then check the spelling.
p15: Turn a casual selfie into a professional headshot for your CV and LinkedIn.
Use a front-facing photo without sunglasses.
p16: A founder-style profile photo for your website, proposals or press.
Great for business-owner profiles on a website or catalog.
p17: Blue-purple neon lighting like a scene from a film.
Works best with a slightly side-facing photo.
p18: A magazine-cover portrait with a sharp gaze.
Add "with the magazine title STYLE at the top" if you want a title too.
p19: A dramatic scene under a stormy sky, like a movie poster.
Swap "serious expression" for "looking up at the sky" for a more poetic feel.
p20: Viral trend: your present self hugging your childhood self.
Upload two photos: one current and one from childhood. If the childhood photo is blurry, restore it first with the Old Photo Restoration recipe.
